Name          Type      Effects                             
------------  --------  ------------------------------------
Vicious Bond  SENTINEL  Companion melee attacks strip 2.5%  
                        of enemy armor; spreads to nearby   
                        enemies within 1.5m.                
Sepsis Claws  MELEE     +30% Toxin; +30% Status Chance;     
                        Converts all elemental damage to    
                        Toxin damage.
